caption: The drawing depicts a section of a stair railing with three vertical wrought iron balusters, two of which are fully illustrated and one rendered in outline. The balusters feature ornate, symmetrical designs incorporating stylized floral and scroll motifs, with vertical bars in the center resembling a lyre. The colors are primarily grayscale, utilizing different shades of brown and gray to create depth and shadow on the two detailed balusters, while the third baluster on the right is shown as a simple pencil outline without any shading or color. The railing at the top is straight and depicted in a plain gray color, running diagonally from the upper left to the upper right edge of the drawing. The composition is balanced, with the railing and balusters occupying the majority of the image, set against a plain, uncolored background. A signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Iron Bannister
